name: Monkey Kingdom
rootCause: The NFT project Monkey Kindom stated that hackers stole $1.3 million in SOL from the community through a security breach in discord. The hacker first attacked Grape, the solution to authenticate users on Solana, and took advantage of the vulnerability to take over an administrative account that posted a phishing link in the announcement channel of Monkey Kindom discord.

descriptions.text: The NFT project Monkey Kindom stated that hackers stole $1.3 million in SOL from the community through a security breach in discord. The hacker first attacked Grape, the solution to authenticate users on Solana, and took advantage of the vulnerability to take over an administrative account that posted a phishing link in the announcement channel of Monkey Kindom discord.

Monkey Kingdom's Solana NFT community suffered a Discord-admin phishing incident during a presale on 2021-12-21, resulting in reported losses of approximately 7,000 SOL (about $1.3 million). The attacker exploited privileged access to post a fraudulent mint link, draining users’ funds. The project established a compensation fund in response. The attacker gained privileged Discord admin access during an NFT presale, reportedly due to a compromise of the Grape user-verification tool or a webhook vulnerability.
